'''Karflo Corporation''' was the manufacturer of the [[G2-GE beamdrill/Legends|G2-GE]] and the [[G2-GS]] [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrills]]. They also held interests in heavy [[Mining/Legends|mining]], xenobiotechnology, and colonial exploration.

==History==
During the conflict with the [[Eternal Empire]], the [[Company/Legends|company]] bought innovative start-up companies and kept their ideas secret to secure an own industrial monopoly.<ref name="Monopoly">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|You Can't Stop Progress}}</ref>

After the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the company became a voting sponsor of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and received a seat on its [[Executive Directorship Board]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The Karflo Corporation once attempted to establish a colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gargolyn IV]]. During the first wave, they forcibly relocated a [[Cor village|village]] of the native [[Cor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In doing so, they unleashed a [[Gargolyn monster|monster]] that had been bound to the land by a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="PW">{{WEGCite|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen|story=A Perfect World}}</ref>
